sources.entry: Arm Neoverse V2 Core Technical Reference Manual - Names an Arm server core's load-side and store-side prefetchers, its TLB levels and the bits that disable them.

summary.title: Arm Neoverse V2 Core Technical Reference Manual
summary.one_liner: This Arm page is a landing page for the Neoverse V2 Core Technical Reference Manual (r0p2), which is only available as a PDF download; the page text itself does not show the prefetcher or TLB details.
keywords: which arm core manual covers prefetchers
takeaways: The page is the download entry point for the Neoverse V2 Core TRM, version r0p2 (marked Latest); r0p1 is superseded.
The manual is aimed at system designers, system integrators, and programmers building a SoC that uses an Arm core.
The document is only available as a PDF; this page text does not include its technical contents such as prefetchers, TLBs, or disable bits.
summary.summary: The page is a documentation landing page on support.arm.com for the Arm Neoverse V2 Core Technical Reference Manual. It lists two versions, r0p2 (Latest) and r0p1 (Superseded), and offers a PDF download, since the manual is only published as a PDF. The rest of the page text is cookie consent material. The page text does not contain the technical details (prefetchers, TLB levels, disable bits) that the directory listing mentions, so those details must be read in the PDF itself.
